title: Page 48 (fixture copied from the real mssEC 18 p.48 record: the 'text' key, Beckwith's 1.30 PM entry first)
text:
130 PM
Beckwith Culpeper  Wash Apl 21 1864
magic . The Govrs of biscay adorn agate & alias
are here & propose to offer to the Govt
Brown Yoke Zebra spit to be ready for the
opinion clothed orbited & fully ridged within Nelson days
from date of notice and to serve for the
yacht of Benton months in Suggestions or where ever
their services may be required & in any State
tulip The quotient would be glad to have your
opinion as to whether this offer should be accepted
or refused Yawl beach Harriet Genesis Oliver Allen End


Geo Sheldon ( 1 )  Washn Apr 21st 1864 3.30 PM
Jennie For Lt Paradise H Biggs Vinton Is your
Whig coming Sugar Wick daily by mangle period At
present orders stop every thing coming up Attica and
send it to Animal but I have ordered a
large quantity of Wherry which will be needed here
and Persia you are supplied should be allowed to
come here yoke Belcher Oh for wnigs of Dove
